caption: A chocolate bunny stands on a plate under a bright heat lamp, and its ears soften, droop and bend over.

sa.check: A chocolate bunny stands on a plate under a heat lamp.
The parts nearest the lamp go glossy and soften.
The bunny is upright with straight ears at the start.
The softening comes first and the drooping follows.

pc.expect: The softening and drooping only advance while the lamp is on; the bunny does not stand back up or firm up again.
pc.fail: A drooped ear stands back up while the lamp is on; or the ears droop and straighten in turn; or the chocolate sets firm and matt again under the lamp; or the bunny regains a shape it had lost.

pc.expect: The bunny stays one chocolate figure whose ears bend and sag while the rest of it keeps its shape longer.
pc.fail: The bunny keeps sharp straight ears while glossy and plainly bent over; or the whole bunny collapses into a puddle in a single frame; or the bunny turns into another figure; or an ear detaches and stays a whole ear.

pc.expect: The ears bend downward under their own weight and any drip runs down the bunny to the plate.
pc.fail: An ear bends upward toward the lamp; or a drip climbs the bunny; or melted chocolate gathers on the bunny's head and stays; or an ear lifts away and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The change is strongest on the parts nearest the lamp and least on the side away from it.
pc.fail: The side away from the lamp softens while the near side stays firm; or the bunny softens evenly all over while the lamp is plainly on one side; or the ears droop while their surface stays matt and dry.

pc.expect: One bunny on one plate; the chocolate goes only from the bunny onto the plate.
pc.fail: The bunny grows; or a second bunny appears; or the bunny vanishes while still whole; or chocolate appears on the plate with no run reaching it.

pc.expect: The bunny's colour, the plate and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The bunny changes colour; or the plate changes shape; or items around the plate rearrange.
